_note: What this file is (plain words): the numbers I measured myself when correcting the guides after the second honesty check. Both slate tiles (the old default and the new default) were scored with lib/texture_compare.py in two ways: with the strength-7 normal map (integration/make_normal.py, the file normal.png in each outputs folder) and with the harness's own two-neighbour normal map. For the new default the harness normal is the stored outputs/default/normal_harness_sobel.png (unchanged, only linked). For the old default that file was not kept, so make_harness_normal_from_height.py (the same formula as lib/bake_harness.py, sobel_normal, strength 7.370340178505459 taken from outputs/default_before_look_fixes/bake.json) made it again from the stored 16-bit height; no Blender run was needed. The temporary folders (links and one 8-bit PNG) were in the scratchpad and were deleted, so the 'candidate' paths inside the raw score files are not kept.
reading: Normal group: strength-7 normal 0.671 to 0.616 (down 0.055); harness normal 0.604 to 0.690 (up 0.086). So the normal group moves by about 0.07 either way depending on the method: a weak signal, not a loss. Overall: 0.705 to 0.778 with the strength-7 normal, 0.695 to 0.789 with the harness normal. These equal the numbers of verify/after_look_fixes/rescore_before_both_normals.json and rescore_now_both_normals.json.
